bluetooth_confirm.title: Minewtech D15N Beacon discovered
bluetooth_confirm.description:
A Minewtech D15N beacon was found nearby.

Address: `{address}`
Stable identifier: `{stable_id}`

Do you want to add it to Home Assistant?

user.title: Add a Minewtech D15N Beacon
user.description: Pick a D15N beacon currently in range. If your beacon isn't listed, move it closer or check that it is powered on.

label.title: Manual setup
label.description:
No stable identifier can be derived from this beacon's advertisements. Give it a memorable name to keep tracking it across MAC rotations.

Note: this label becomes the device identifier. If the beacon is factory-reset, a new entry has to be created.

error.no_stable_id: Could not extract a stable identifier from the advertisement. Try the manual setup with a label instead.
error.label_in_use: This label is already used by another beacon. Choose a more specific name (e.g. 'Mama’s keychain' instead of 'keys').

abort.already_configured: This Minewtech D15N is already set up in Home Assistant.
abort.device_lost: The selected beacon is no longer in range. Move it closer and try again.
abort.no_devices_found: No Minewtech D15N beacons are currently visible to Home Assistant. Make sure the beacon is powered on and within Bluetooth range.
abort.no_stable_id: This advertisement does not carry a stable identifier (no iBeacon, no Eddystone-UID, and the BLE address is not pattern-stable). Use the manual setup with a label to track the beacon anyway.
abort.not_d15n: This Bluetooth device does not look like a Minewtech D15N beacon.

init.title: Minewtech D15N options
init.description: Tune how long Home Assistant waits before marking the beacon as away.

data_description.max_age_seconds: If no advertisement is seen for this many seconds, the device_tracker switches to 'not_home'. Lower values catch departures faster but flap when the signal is briefly blocked. Default: 300.
